نتخاطب (form VI)
# نَتَخَاطَبُ (nataḵāṭabu) /na.ta.xaː.tˤa.bu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَخَاطَبَ (taḵāṭaba)
# نَتَخَاطَبَ (nataḵāṭaba) /na.ta.xaː.tˤa.ba/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَخَاطَبَ (taḵāṭaba)
# نَتَخَاطَبْ (nataḵāṭab) /na.ta.xaː.tˤab/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَخَاطَبَ (taḵāṭaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
